info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Model Liquidity Risk Model-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of liquidity risk model specifications within the banking sector, facilitating financial institutions to effectively assess and manage liquidity risk. Users can define important parameters for liquidity risk assessments, which are essential in regulatory reporting and internal risk management processes. Typical consumers of this API include risk management teams, financial analysts, and compliance officers. The API streamlines the process of establishing models that help organizations mitigate potential liquidity shortfalls and enhance financial stability.
